verdict.rationale: There is no documented public REST or GraphQL management API in the evidence, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Hoppscotch does offer documented programmatic surfaces: an official MCP server that lets an agent read and change collections, requests, environments and teams, and a CLI for automated systems to run tests and manage collections. These approximate API-driven control but are not a public API as the story asks. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP API with reference docs or an OpenAPI spec, API auth/token docs, and independent corroboration of programmatic control.
